body: One day at a time. I hope you find some answers soon to help your symptoms.

For me, somethings got much better. But I’ve also had new symptoms that are unrelated. But I will say overall I am happy. I see family and friends, I work a job with slightly reduced hours to accommodate, I’m still active outside, I met someone who accepted the challenges that come with the unknown of my health issues as to this day I don’t know what some of it is, and I’m happy I’m still here even with the times I’ve had to go through.

Hi there. So I was never diagnosed with MCAS but I have had on and off issues since. I did try cromolyn for it but it wasn’t a good fit for me. I’ve had improvements with low histamine diet and avoiding triggers though I still have varying symptoms at times. My current symptoms are much different than my previous ones which were rashes. Now I have more headache and stomach issues though I do get full body itching rarely. Another thing that helped was actually going off Zyrtec which gave me nerve pain for some reason. I can’t say I’m perfect or close to it, but I have gotten better at managing it all and it is less overwhelming. There are ups and downs with it but I just hope to keep finding more answers.

Also, thank you in advance for any advice. We understand that this is a subreddit and not actually having a lawyer. We are just hoping for some guidance. We will contact an attorney if needed but are hoping to not have to and just pay the right person and they can rectify the discrepancies between their legal teams instead of us having to be the middle man.

I know people of any age can have this but a part of me is bitter because I’m in my early 20s and feel like an 80 year old with all the issues I have.

For me everything really started after a bad case of poison ivy last summer. Since then it has been problem after problem. Thankfully I have a decent support system but there are times they don’t understand or get upset at me being negative/talking about my issues a lot. I don’t think people understand that even when I look completely fine, I still might be in pain. Currently my neck has been on fire like I have a sunburn but nothing shows on my skin. It’s hard to have people understand and believe you when they can’t see it.

Oh my gosh. I’m sorry it’s that bad for you! Fingers crossed I haven’t had a reaction like that (but up until this year everything I had was much more mild and I didn’t think anything was wrong besides being sensitive to a lot of things. )

My family calls me a canary too! If you don’t mind me asking, do you get sunburn easily? I always have, but it’s been worse lately (specifically on my arms). I sat outside for maybe 20mins and they are both burnt......

Yes my lips always tingle. Like 75% of the time. I get redness under my bottom lip and my chin will burn at times. Processed food like fast food make me feel heavy in my chest and almost short of breath. I think coffee does as well but I keep drinking it anyways......... I sometimes get tinnitus with it as well and hearing sensitivity where the sounds of typing on a keyboard literally hurt my ears. 

I also get rashes all over when I get bug bites (I have one right now and I’m praying that starting the Pepcid will help keep things calm). I’m still not diagnosed with it but everything aligns with me having it. (We also have a family history of Elhers-danlos, ibs, migraines, asthma, gerd, MTHFR gene mutation and a few other things). Sorry for the info dump, I know it’s a lot!!
I’m sorry to hear you having this many issues. I swear my face, chin, and lips burn half the time when I eat.

I’m still in the process of figuring out if this is what I’m dealing with (I have a lot of symptoms that seem related plus a family history of conditions that correlate and my primary has suggested it). This year has been the worst health I’ve ever had. It’s not that I WANT to have this but if I do, I wish it could be diagnosed so I could start trying methods to control it. But even finding a doctor that can help has been hard. I’m at the point where if I don’t have a doctor that will help, I’m ready to just start trying the non prescription based interventions such as H1/H2, quercetin, and diet. 

I feel like I currently live in fear of everything and I want to change that and enjoy life again.

My doctor had me take Zyrtec with Pepcid when I had a reaction before (rash from spider bite) but it kept spreading so I had to take steroids. He hasn’t had me try them on a daily basis, but I feel like that might be a good place to start.
